skill.summary: Generates detailed offboarding checklists, knowledge transfer plans, compliance steps, manager transitions, and day-by-day timelines for departing employees.

latestVersion.changelog:
afrexai-offboarding v1.0.0

- Initial release of Employee Offboarding Manager skill.
- Generates comprehensive offboarding checklists and transition plans based on departing employee’s details.
- Covers IT & access revocation, knowledge transfer, HR and compliance actions, and managerial transition steps.
- Provides a structured timeline from notice to last day.
- Works with any AI agent platform, requiring no API keys—context-only.
